mission: Restore staging DB reads (owner 2026-10-21 09:00Z, first priority): since 07:14Z every ops-readonly db-diagnostic and staging-state run failed at `railway variable list -s <postgres> --json` (exit non-zero) while `railway status` and `railway api` reads kept working with the same token. Report the CLI exit code and a failure class (never its output), and read service variables through the documented `variables` GraphQL query via `railway api` when the CLI read fails. Every delivery verify and the collector rollout read Postgres variables the same way, so this lands before the next delivery.

impacts.reason: command_json failure text gains '<cmd> <sub> read failed (exit N, <class>)'; the class comes from a fixed regex list matched in memory, the output is never reported. railway() names the GraphQL error class. New service_variables(service_id): CLI first, then `railway api` query variables(projectId, environmentId, serviceId) on the same pinned staging ids; the CLI failure line goes to stderr. database_snapshot uses it.
Postgres (and collector) variable reads call state.service_variables instead of the CLI directly. Same values, same in-memory handling, same read-only connections; no new destination.
Exit/class reported without output or secret, failure classes, CLI success used directly, CLI failure falls back to the API query with pinned ids, both failing raises a classified error.

resources: GitHub Actions ops-readonly, ops-write, staging-automerge, Verify staging merge
routes: Railway GraphQL via `railway api` (variables query, staging project/environment only)
impact.deployment_impact: No collector rollout, no RAW migration, no fleet change.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR of this merge with its own docs/agent/missions/<name>.json; reads return to the CLI-only path.
recovery.trigger: The fallback reads a different destination, or any run output shows a variable value.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: This PR's own delivery verify (reads Postgres variables through the new path), then one ops-readonly db-diagnostic; its log names the CLI failure class.
